corpus.note: every event NCDR indexes at /server/v1/Generic/capZip, alertTypeId=33, deduplicated by identifier

howToRegenerate: GET https://alerts.ncdr.nat.gov.tw/server/v1/Generic/capZip  -> 62 events, each with a pk
Keyless. Throttle to <1 req/sec; the public feed on the same host 429s at 3s intervals and took ~65s to recover.
severityRule: Extreme <=> 上班 suspended. Zero counter-examples in the 1,266 records that use the modern format. Severe and Minor both mean 'not a 停班' and are NOT two distinct meanings.
